verdict.rationale: A state revenue agency could reasonably publish bulk public datasets, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such downloads. The reemployment tax XML package is a filing schema. The large-data-file program and batch enrollment files are inbound submission channels for employers and agents, not public-data extracts. The probes show only login-gated transactional surfaces.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
